verdict.rationale: Abacum's own docs say it brings spreadsheet data, alongside ERP, CRM, HRIS and warehouse data, into one governed source of truth, and its Excel connector lets users push data from Excel into Abacum. That supports spreadsheets as a data source, but the evidence never mentions CSV file upload or describes how spreadsheet data is treated as a source. missing for 10: explicit CSV/file upload capability, documentation of spreadsheet ingestion as a first-class source (mapping, refresh, governance parity with connectors), independent or hands-on corroboration.
